snippet.title: Forgotten American Brands
snippet.description:
Forgotten American Brands takes you back to the stores, restaurants, and companies that shaped everyday American life — and then vanished.
📼 From mall anchors to fast food legends, from beloved tech gadgets to iconic car names — we tell the full story. The rise. The glory. The collapse.
🕰️ These weren't just businesses. They were Saturday mornings, road trips, Christmas catalogs, and first jobs. They were part of who we were.
🎬 Every episode is a full documentary — 40 to 50 minutes of real history, real people, and real memories.
🔔 Subscribe and hit the bell — so you never miss the story of a brand you thought you'd never forget.

snippet.title: Behind the Bill
snippet.description:
Welcome to Behind the Bill – where we break down the economy in simple words.
Discover how money really works, why prices keep rising, what inflation means for your wallet, and the hidden forces driving financial markets, global trade, and personal wealth. Whether it’s supply chains, interest rates, government debt, or corporate greed—we reveal what’s really happening behind the numbers.
Perfect for anyone interested in economics, finance, money management, economic news, market trends, or understanding today’s financial world—without the boring jargon.

🔔 Subscribe to stay ahead of inflation, recession risks, global economics, and everything impacting your income and savings.

Economics isn’t just for experts—it’s for everyone. Let’s decode it together.

snippet.title: Once Upon a Company
snippet.description:
Once Upon a Company explores the fascinating stories of businesses that once ruled industries—but eventually disappeared.
We dive into 100–200 year old companies, legendary brands, and forgotten business empires to uncover how they rose, what went wrong, and why they vanished.

Each video is a faceless, documentary-style story covering:
The rise and fall of historic companies
Billion-dollar mistakes and business failures
Old American, British, and Canadian corporations
Lessons modern entrepreneurs can learn from the past
If you love business history, corporate failures, and untold stories, this channel is for you.

📺 New videos every week
🌍 Focused on USA, UK & Canada business history
